In real-world usage 🔘 lives in the spaces where the sender wants to communicate selection-marker energy. A partner sends it on a 'solid-black 🔘' selection-marker marker. The solid-black fill cue is what makes the emoji feel solid-black coded — it is not just 'shape,' it is 'solid-black coded radio-shape moment.'
